root.label: Variadic templates and folds
root.note: A pack stands for zero or more arguments and can only be expanded.

children.label: Kinds of pack
children.note: Packs exist at every level a template can be parameterized.

children.label: Template packs
children.note: Type, non-type and template template packs: class... Ts, int... Ns.

children.label: Function parameter packs
children.note: Ts... xs; C++20 lambdas add init-capture packs [...ys = xs].

children.label: sizeof...
children.note: Counts elements as a std::size_t constant; unrelated to object sizes.

children.label: Pack expansion
children.note: pattern... repeats the whole pattern once per element.

children.label: Pattern placement
children.note: f(g(xs)...) calls g per element; g(f(xs...)) calls g once.

children.label: Lockstep packs
children.note: Several packs in one pattern must have the same length.

children.label: List contexts only
children.note: Arguments, initializers, bases, captures, using-declarations and folds.

children.label: xs + 1...
children.note: 1... lexes as one pp-number; write (xs + 1)... instead.

children.label: Fold forms
children.note: C++17 reduces a pack with one of 32 binary operators.

children.label: Unary right
children.note: (E op ...) groups as E1 op (E2 op E3).

children.label: Unary left
children.note: (... op E) groups as (E1 op E2) op E3.

children.label: Binary folds
children.note: (E op ... op I) and (I op ... op E) add an initial value.

children.label: Operand restriction
children.note: The operand is a cast-expression: parenthesize xs * 2 inside a fold.

children.label: Empty packs
children.note: Only three unary folds have a value for zero elements.

children.label: && and ||
children.note: An empty && fold is true and an empty || fold is false.

children.label: Comma
children.note: An empty comma fold is void().

children.label: Everything else
children.note: Empty unary + or * is ill-formed; use a binary fold with an identity.

children.label: Evaluation order
children.note: Which expansions run their elements first to last.

children.label: Comma fold
children.note: (f(xs), ...) is sequenced left to right, in either fold direction.

children.label: Call arguments
children.note: sink(f(xs)...) evaluates the elements in unspecified order.

children.label: Overloaded comma
children.note: Cast to void, (void(f(xs)), ...), to bypass a user operator comma.

children.label: Packs and deduction
children.note: How a pack gets its length.

children.label: Trailing pack
children.note: A last function parameter pack deduces one element per remaining argument.

children.label: Non-trailing pack
children.note: Never deduced from the call; supply it explicitly.

children.label: Forwarding packs
children.note: Args&&... args with std::forward<Args>(args)... keeps each category.
